verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents date-based API versioning (e.g., /crm/2026-09/), stating that previous versions keep working until their end-of-life date to give integrators time to migrate. It also maintains a sunsetted/deprecated APIs table with dates and migration targets, with future changes announced on the Developer Changelog; versioned paths also appear in practice (/crm/v3/). Missing for 10: a quantified minimum support window between deprecation and end-of-life (the policy says only 'ample notice' and 'foreseeable future'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy in practice.
